analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md was changed. Both supplied units are head-side documentation text (lines 454-991), and the patch excerpt shows a version bump to v0.10.3 with a note that MLX submodule pointers moved (libs/mlx-swift eedca444 to 4926d3d9, libs/mlx to 31f550af). I found no executable code, key handling, attestation logic, authorization or crypto change in the supplied evidence, so no regression is evident.

The changelog text describes several security-relevant behaviors. Nothing visible contradicts the threat model:
- Prefix cache (T-041): Nemotron prefix reuse is partitioned by the authenticated cache scope. The GLM SSD prefix store is default-on and reports a typed failure reason. A DEBUG-only cache key file is stated to be absent from release builds.
- Model weight hashing (T-012, T-027): hashing now uses uncached reads, with digests stated as unchanged.
- Dev and staging release lanes: a relaxed installer signature check is described as applying only to versions carrying -dev. or -staging. Production is described as keeping the Apple-team requirement, and prod as tag-gated. This is documentation only, and the installer and workflow code were not supplied.
- New media decode limits (images, video) for Nemotron and GLM, described as protecting against DoS.

Open questions are for source-level review if those files appear in another batch, not findings here:
- Whether scripts/install.sh really limits the relaxed signature path to pre-release versions.
- Whether the DEBUG-only DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE path is compiled out of release builds.
- Whether the MLX submodule bump (4926d3d9, 31f550af) carries any unreviewed native-kernel changes. The supplied patch excerpt is truncated and cannot establish this.
